headline: T-Pain Sues Akon’s Konvict Entertainment Over $489K Royalties
body: T-Pain has filed an 80-page lawsuit in Fulton County Superior Court alleging Konvict Entertainment (Akon’s imprint) owes him $489,047 in unpaid royalties. The claim stems from a $1.3 million royalty payment received by Konvict on March 30, 2026, from Zomba Recordings. Documents obtained by XXL report the lawsuit was filed on Sept. 4, 2026, with T-Pain claiming the label failed to disburse the full amount. This legal move comes amid ongoing royalty disputes in the music industry.

The lawsuit, detailed in an 80-page filing, claims Konvict owes $489,047 from a $1.3M payment from Zomba Recordings. With the music industry rife with similar disputes, this case could set a precedent for artists fighting label payment practices.
